title: Central configuration drift guard with deterministic baseline

phases.objective: Reject unapproved configuration candidate drift and guard authority, contract, baseline, suppression, and safety invariants without mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An unchanged baseline passes; a new unsuppressed candidate fails; a valid future-dated suppression passes; an expired suppression fails; and safety flags cannot authorize mutation.
steps: Load the deterministic baseline and current candidate inventory.
Compare candidate fingerprints and classify new, suppressed, and removed entries.
Verify read-only authority registration and E2E scope coverage.
Reject invalid or expired suppressions and unsuppressed new candidates.
Verify report-only, no-migration, no-runtime-mutation, no-Production-activation, and no-secret invariants.
assertions: The baseline comparison is deterministic and does not select a first candidate on ambiguity.
New candidates fail closed unless covered by a non-expired owner-scoped suppression.
Expired suppressions fail closed and cannot silently become accepted baseline entries.
The guard never writes repository files, database rows, protected refs, or Production state.
No raw secret value is included in drift evidence.

phases.objective: Require reviewed baseline refreshes and bounded suppression lifecycle changes through exact-head governance and independent Owner evidence.
The Drift Guard cannot authorize write scopes, Production activation, or external mutations.
